description: Colour scheme select (EDITOR-ARCHITECTURE.md §4.3): color_scheme = page | cream | grey | accent | ink, default page. page = the theme palette, exactly today, and emits nothing; any other value puts data-color-scheme="<id>" on the section/block root (snippets/section-style.liquid, part 'attrs'), where css-variables re-maps the colour tokens to that scheme (Theme settings › Colour schemes).
